name: matching_delimiter
description: Identify the single closing delimiter matching the last unmatched opener, contrasting transformation with a matched explicit-close copy task. Separates delimiter type mapping from full nested suffix generation.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
pairs=dict(zip('([{',')]}'))
for i in range(120):
 opens=''.join(random.choice('([{') for _ in range(random.randint(1,4))); content=random.choice(['x','value','a + b','item','n','42']); fragment=opens+content; close=pairs[opens[-1]]
 template='Text: '+fragment+'\nWhich single closing bracket should come next?\nAnswer:'
 items.append({'prompt':template,'answer':' '+close})
 control.append({'prompt':'Text: '+fragment+'\nThe next closing bracket is '+close+'. Copy that single bracket.\nAnswer:','answer':' '+close})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
